Ocient raises $100 million as agentic AI drives growth in large-scale analytics. Ocient Inc., the maker of a speedy data analytics platform, today said it has raised $100 million in a Series C funding to expand its agentic artificial intelligence analytics business. EloElo Group Raises $80M Series C. EloElo Group raises $80 million in Series C funding led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal to expand its AI-powered entertainment platform globally.
Nooks Raises $500M Growth Capital. Nooks raises $500 million in growth capital from General Catalyst to scale its revenue agent platform and launch its new AI sales assistant, Node.

Sector Snapshot: Construction Robotics Funding Soars To $1.6B, Tripling Previous Peak. Companies spanning construction and robotics have raised about $1.6 billion so far this year  — more than 4x the $389 million recorded in all of 2025 — according to Crunchbase data. The surge was driven by three companies that raised the majority of the funding.
Mindmax Raises $3.3M in Funding. Mindmax raises $3.3M in funding led by Concept Ventures to advance its AI-powered interactive learning platform for professional exam preparation.
Lazarus AI Raises $43M in Funding. Lazarus AI raises $43 million to scale its independent AI platform that allows enterprises and governments to retain control over their data and models.
